excerpts.text: IMAP launched on September 24, 2025 at 07:30 EDT (11:30 UTC) aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Launch Complex 39A at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida, USA.

* September 24, 2025: IMAP successfully launched from Kennedy Space Center aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket at 07:30 EDT. Flight controllers at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory confirmed spacecraft acquisition at approximately 08:57 EDT. The spacecraft executed planned solar array deployment and initial attitude maneuvers as designed. Preliminary telemetry indicates all ten science instruments and all spacecraft subsystems are functioning nominally. 25)
